name: KCS
name_zh: 深圳宽诚集成电路技术有限公司
summary: KCS designs analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits in Shenzhen. Its servo-control IC portfolio supports model-aircraft and robot servos, with external-drive controller ICs and integrated H-bridge devices. It also supplies general motor and gate-driver ICs and application engineering support.
categories: Robot Control Boards and Computing Components
